top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Gain as Tech Bounces Back, Bonds Drop: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks climbed as technology shares rebounded from Thursday’s losses, with investors starting to look beyond the leadership turmoil at Nvidia Corp. and refocus on the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
